gen-fs-oswald-gf-encode-sans-semi-expand: Oswald packs its rows tight and speaks with a confident, strong voice. Oswald grabs attention in compact lines, while Encode Sans Semi Expanded, the sans-serif beneath, keeps its rounded letters open and contemporary.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-exo-2: Oswald crowds its letters into tightly knit rows, giving headings a confident, strong presence that is hard to ignore. Exo 2, plain sans below, lets its daylight-filled curves do the quiet part.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-gayathri: Oswald sets confident, strong letters in tightly knit rows, with little stroke contrast. And Gayathri, plain sans with restrained stroke variation and open-ended curves, makes extended reading feel approachable.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-google-sans: Smooth and approachable, this sans draws each stroke without modulation, terminals pulled well back. Google Sans keeps the text flowing beneath Oswald, whose tightly knit headings supply the confidence.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-google-sans-flex: Google Sans Flex reads modern and professional, ending every curve in a clean, open gap with stroke ends cut like one ribbon. Oswald adds tight, strong headings on top of that smooth texture.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-gothic-a1: Approachable at heart, Gothic A1 lets its c terminal splay open. Oswald takes the loud role in its tightly knit, confident rows, while the plain sans underneath talks in a softer voice.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: IBM Plex Sans JP reads approachable, each curve ending in a clean gap. Beneath tightly knit, confident Oswald headings, this plain sans keeps text moving paragraph after paragraph without tiring the eye.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: Confident and strong, Oswald packs its letters into tightly knit rows that grab attention the moment a heading appears. IBM Plex Sans Thai, modern sans-serif, does the quiet detail work.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-lato: Clean against confident: Oswald crams its letters into tightly knit rows while Lato, a sans, stays wide-curved and quiet. Loud meets gentle, and that tension is the whole appeal of this pair.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-lunasima: Tightly knit rows define Oswald, a confident, strong display face. Lunasima, this plain sans, can go a touch larger than usual, since its c tips never creep toward touching.
